# Free Printable Pumpkin Carving Stencils


Share:


- [Share Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/sharer.php?u=https://onceuponafarmorganics.com/blogs/upon-a-blog/free-printable-pumpkin-carving-stencils)
- [Tweet Tweet on Twitter](https://twitter.com/share?text=&url=https://onceuponafarmorganics.com/blogs/upon-a-blog/free-printable-pumpkin-carving-stencils)


Get ready for festive fall fun, with some Once Upon a Farm flair! Download and print out your favorite stencil(s) from the 6 options below, grab a pumpkin, and get to carving. And don't forget to save the[pumpkin seeds](https://onceuponafarmorganics.com/blogs/upon-a-blog/5-perks-of-pumpkin-seeds) for a yummy snack! 🎃
